return_definition: Total return including dividend adjustments; next session adjusted open to close 252 sessions later. Estimates are before costs and tax.
selection: 60% six-month relative-strength percentile + 40% ROE percentile inside the quality cohort; maximum two per sector, one per industry, trailing daily correlation <= 0.80 with >=126 paired observations. Fewer than five if constraints prevent filling slots. Experimental model estimates do not determine this ranking.
universe: Liquid US stocks, cap >= $2B, revenue growth >=5%, positive operating/net income, cash/profit >=0.7, ROE 5–80%, equity/assets >=5%, operating margin >=5%, liabilities/assets <=80%, annualised volatility <=65%, fresh reconciled accounts. Financials, REITs and unknown sectors excluded.

validation.note: Monthly 12-month cohorts overlap. These are reconstructed, survivor-conditioned diagnostics, not independent trials or a live track record. Range coverage is measured, not guaranteed.
